Obsidian Hybrid Search is a search tool for Obsidian note vaults, offered as a native plugin, a CLI, and an MCP server that share one retrieval engine. It finds notes by meaning as well as by exact words, titles, tags, folders, links, and similar notes, so you don't need to remember the exact wording. It is for Obsidian users who want to find and reuse their own notes, and for AI agents that should start from those notes and cite their source files. It runs locally by default with SQLite, and can optionally use OpenAI-compatible embedding APIs.
